run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit completed across the cluster for namespaces whose name starts with 'app-283'. The cluster lists 11 namespaces, of which exactly four begin with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search. In each of those four namespaces a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' exists and carries a non-empty 'audit_code' key (alongside the keys 'owner' and 'tier'). Values found: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q; app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V; app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z; app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. Each namespace was queried individually and returned exactly one service-manifest object, with the ConfigMap listing for each namespace containing 2 objects in total. No namespace matching the 'app-283' prefix lacks the ConfigMap among those observed. This is a read-only audit observation of cluster state at query time (2026-11-23T19:19:11Z to 2026-11-23T19:19:15Z); no health, latency or incident conclusion is drawn, and no change history is available in this Run.
